dataPage.title: Data sources
dataPage.intro: Pesa shows nutritional values from public sources: Italian first, then French and US. We list license, attribution and contact for each.

imagesPage.title: Image sources
imagesPage.intro: Product images may come from Open Food Facts or Wikimedia Commons. Pesa hosts them with visible attribution where the license permits.
imagesPage.creaBdaNote: Open Food Facts product images are hosted by Pesa with attribution to the Open Food Facts contributors (images CC BY-SA, data ODbL). CREA images are not hosted by Pesa: when an external link is available, it is shown with attribution to the origin.

home.title: How many carbs are in this food?
home.tagline: Type the name, enter the weight in grams, get the carbohydrate value. Data from official public sources, always cited.
home.learnMore: Read what Pesa is for on the page

grams.title: Gram-level calculation
grams.body: Enter the exact weight and read the carbohydrate value for the portion, with context on fiber, sugars, kcal.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Once the catalog is cached, you can search and compute without a network connection.

sources.title: Official sources, cited
sources.body: The Italian CREA table first; Ciqual (France) and USDA (United States) only for what CREA lacks. Every value shows its source.

search.label: Search food
search.empty: No results. Try a different name.
search.offlineNotice: You are offline: results from local cache.

detail.conflictBody: CREA and BDA IEO report different values for this food (>10%). Choose the source to use.

scope.intro: Pesa is a generic nutritional tool that counts carbohydrates by weight.

scopeBanner.body: Pesa shows public nutritional values by weight. It does not replace the opinion of your reference health professional.

scopeFooter.body: Pesa is not a medical device. For food choices tied to personal conditions, talk to your reference health professional.

about.title: About
about.intro: Pesa is an open-source project maintained by Lorenzo Di Mare, published under AGPL v3.
about.scopeLead: What Pesa is and is not for is explained on the page
